0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3) visit the San Antonio Spurs (1-2) in the Kings' fourth game of the season, as they look to end a three-game losing streak, sitting 15th in the West and 3 games back in the Pacific. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Keegan Murray is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision; San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). No games have been played between the teams so far in 2026-27, but the Kings lost 0-3 to the Spurs in 2025-26, including a 132-104 loss in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
